verses.commentary: Go, show your love to your wife again. The command repeats. Though she is loved by another, though she is an adulteress. Gomer has strayed. Love her as the Lord loves Israel. The prophet's painful obedience images God's stubborn love. Sacred raisin cakes: cultic foods of Baal worship.

I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a half of barley. A redemption price. She had fallen so far she needed to be purchased like a slave. Hosea pays to reclaim his own wife. Grace costs the gracious one.

You are to live with me many days. Conditions of restoration. No prostitution, no other men. And I will do the same toward you. Mutual exclusivity. The covenant relationship rebuilt one day at a time.

The Israelites will live many days without king or prince. Political structure stripped. Without sacrifice or sacred stones. Religious apparatus removed. Without ephod or household gods. Priestly and domestic worship gone. A time of deprivation, not punishment.

Afterward the Israelites will return. Exile precedes restoration. They will seek the Lord their God and David their king. Messianic expectation. The true king from David's line. They will come trembling to the Lord and to his blessings. Fear and hope combined. In the last days. The restoration reaches beyond immediate history.
